title: Unit 23 Consolidation: Spatial Urban Geometry, Historic Preservation & Architectural Semiotics
goal: I can master C1 academic vocabulary of urban morphology, Fin-de-Siècle eclecticism, and architectural semiotics.
I can deploy spatial geometric connectors, ornate participial epithets, and stylistic antithesis adverbs.
I can evaluate aesthetic criticism matrix clauses, scalar density metrics, and Szerb Antal's 'Budapesti kalauz'.
